en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large castle complex with formal Renaissance gardens in the foreground. Rectangular lawn sections are divided by gravel paths and low walls, with small trees and shrubs planted symmetrically. The multi‑story stone castle buildings have many windows, arcades, and distinctive chimneys, with mountains and the town spreading out in the background. Printed captions appear in a cursive typeface along the bottom margin.
